name: Saved architecture diagram 2
source:
sequenceDiagram
participant U as Browser
participant A as API
participant S as SessionService
participant R as Repository
participant P as PaymentAdapter
U->>A: POST order with bearer token
A->>S: Authenticate token
S-->>A: User ID or unauthorized
A->>R: Transaction - read owned cart, check stock, snapshot prices
R-->>A: Pending order or validation error
A->>P: Request payment intent
P-->>A: Disabled - no money processed
A-->>U: Order details and payment disabled

name: Saved architecture diagram 10

sequenceDiagram
participant A as API
participant B as Storage
participant C as Authentication
participant D as Product Management
participant E as Cart
participant F as Order
participant G as Payment
A->>C: User login request
C->>B: Validate user
B-->>C: Return user data
C->>A: Return authenticated user

E->>B: Save cart item
B-->>E: Confirm save
A->>F: Place order
F->>B: Save order

F->>G: Process payment
G-->>F: Return test payment status
F-->>A: Return order confirmation
